name: gizza-ai/video-trim
summary: Trim a video to a [start, start+duration] window

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: Video URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

tool.description: Trim a video to a [start, start+duration] window using stream-copy (no re-encode). Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). The output keeps the source container (mp4 stays mp4, webm stays webm, and so on); an unknown container falls back to mp4. Stream-copy preserves the source codecs and is fast and lossless.
